headline: Indian markets face pressure from US inflation fears while IT stocks rally and Jio announces mega IPO

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Hot US inflation data has stirred global worries regarding potential interest rate hikes
A sharp sell-off in US tech and AI shares has dampened global investor sentiment
Selling pressure in domestic banking, pharma, and auto sectors has weighed on the indices
Nifty has slipped below key psychological levels including 22,700 and 22,650
whatHappening: Jio Platforms has announced India's largest ever IPO of ₹30,213 crore, set for October 21
The CCEA has cleared Fairfax to take the reins at IDBI Bank in a major FDI move
IT giants Infosys and TCS are rallying, providing a necessary cushion to the broader market
HDB Financial Services reported a significant 34% jump in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹780 crore
summary: The Indian stock market is navigating volatility as hot US inflation data fuels global rate-hike fears, impacting tech and AI sectors. Despite broader indices like the Nifty slipping below 22,650, IT stocks like Infosys and TCS are showing resilience. Major corporate news includes Jio Platforms' upcoming ₹30,213 crore IPO and the government's clearance for Fairfax to acquire a stake in IDBI Bank.
